QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] To Pantheon
QuestInfo.0: Kain, a passing traveler, seems to want a word with you.
QuestInfo.1: Through Kain's guidance, you've agreed to help the Nova. Go to Pantheon to meet Beldar.
QuestInfo.2: You've met Beldar in Pantheon. Hear him out to get the details of the mission.

0.msg: Go straight to Pantheon and meet Beldar.
